description: Standing query, zero results expected: no successful Identity Center or Identity Store change in the last three days by anyone but the operator's elevated role, the elevation workflow and its backstop, Identity Center's service-linked role, or a user's own Identity Center sign-in. api.read_only and metadata.event_category exist from 2026-10-07 00:25 UTC (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-06), so the window fills over the following three days.

params.query: SELECT dt, actor.user.type AS type, regexp_replace(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), '^arn:aws:sts::\d+:assumed-role/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') AS actor, api.operation AS operation, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND status = 'Success' AND api.read_only = false AND api.service.name IN ('sso.amazonaws.com', 'identitystore.amazonaws.com', 'sso-directory.amazonaws.com') AND NOT regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/(AWSReservedSSO_ElevatedAdmin_[0-9a-f]+|fedramp-20x-ksi-elevation(-workflow)?|AWSServiceRoleForSSO)/') AND NOT (actor.user.type = 'IdentityCenterUser' AND api.service.name IN ('sso.amazonaws.com', 'signin.amazonaws.com', 'sso-oauth.amazonaws.com')) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: AWS only: Google Admin's audit log of directory changes is not collected. And there is no declared pipeline for identity: the operator's elevated role is the declared changer.
